scenarios: A completion verification of an epic/container ticket whose plan uses a `## Success Criteria` heading (as the authoring guide instructs) — those criteria are now skipped rather than verified.
spec-alignment eval cases in eval_solver.py that build epic descriptions with `## Success Criteria`.

dropped.finding: test_no_success_criteria_vocabulary_in_the_reviewer_prompts globs ALL `*.md` in the reviewers dir (which includes non-plan-review prompts such as security.md, tests.md, code-review-*.md, ticket_quality.md) minus three hardcoded excludes, so any legitimate future use of 'success criteria' as generic English in an unrelated reviewer prompt would fail this test as a false positive.
scenarios: A later change adds 'success criteria' as ordinary prose to any reviewer prompt outside the three excluded files — this test fails even though the collapse invariant it means to protect is intact.
